desc:
🔗 CHAINED TOGETHER. DON’T SPLASH.

Team up with 1–4 players and make your way through the eerie poolrooms. Jump across moving, rotating, and sinking platforms while a monster lurks in the water below.

💧 Fall in? Your teammates will have to pull you out.
🧨 Use distractions, flares, and tools to help your team survive.
⚠️ Every jump matters. There are no checkpoints.
🔥 Brave enough? Take on Hard Mode.

Stick together. Keep the chain tight. DON’T SPLASH.
